user.title: Git Config Sync
user.description: When the Git Config Sync app runs on this Home Assistant you do not need this form: restart Home Assistant after installing the integration and add it from Settings → Devices & services → Discovered. If it does not show up there, open the app's web UI: its "Home Assistant integration" section shows the host, port and API token to enter here.

data_description.host: The app's hostname, shown on its Info page and in its web UI (e.g. ff19ed62-homeassistant-config-sync).
data_description.token: Shown in the app's web UI, "Home Assistant integration" section.

hassio_confirm.title: Git Config Sync
hassio_confirm.description: Add the Git Config Sync app as an integration? You get its sync state, a problem sensor, the secret scanner's findings, and a Sync now button.

reauth_confirm.title: Git Config Sync
reauth_confirm.description: The app rejected the API token. Enter the current one, shown in the app's web UI ("Home Assistant integration" section).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the app.
error.invalid_auth: The app rejected the API token.

abort.already_configured: Git Config Sync is already set up.
